title: Non-Invasive Treatment of Early Diabetic Macular Edema by Multiwavelength Photobiomodulation with the Valeda Light Delivery System

license.statement: Dove Medical Press licence incorporating CC BY-NC 3.0 (unported) (article <license>); non-commercial, so private

condition: Early-stage diabetic macular edema with good vision (BCVA better than 20/25, intraretinal fluid on OCT, no urgent need for intravitreal therapy); retrospective single-centre open-label post-hoc case series (Dusseldorf), 30 eyes of 19 subjects; some eyes had earlier intravitreal therapy more than 6 weeks before

groups.agent: multiwavelength photobiomodulation (Valeda Light Delivery System; 590, 660 and 850 nm LED), one series of 9 sessions delivered 3 times per week over 3-4 weeks
groups.description: All analysed eyes (30 eyes, 19 subjects); role 'treated' because photobiomodulation is the novel treatment under evaluation, not a standard DME treatment

series.notes: Central 1 mm subfield retinal thickness (Methods); Cirrus 5000 and 6000; Table 1 'Mean (SD)' row (descriptive means; the linear mixed effects model was used only for comparisons); Month 1 = visit immediately after the 9 sessions (3-4 weeks after the first session) and Month 3 = '~3 months follow-up', both used at their nominal labels; n = 30 eyes at Month 1 stated in Results, Month 3 n not stated for CRT; anti-VEGF injections were given after PBM to some eyes at the physicians' discretion and their values were not removed (means over all analysed eyes)

exclusions.reason: macular volume is out of scope

exclusions.what: Table 1 R8-R13 intraretinal fluid and cyst counts
Safety OCT review up to 16 months
exclusions.reason: no tabulated central thickness at those times

notes: Prior treatment mixed: some eyes had received intravitreal anti-VEGF before PBM (latest more than 6 weeks before baseline), the others were treatment naive (Results)
Thirty eyes of 19 subjects: both eyes of some subjects are included
Time origin: the Baseline visit before the first PBM session; the PBM series was modified in some cases for scheduling conflicts (Methods)
Number and intervals of post-PBM intravitreal injections are reported in the article and not extracted
